validation: Split by district, not at random. Neighbouring cells are autocorrelated, so a random split trains on a cell's own neighbours and reports an accuracy that means nothing.
notes: Baseline is the physics chain: Lee filter, Otsu threshold, change detection against a pre-event scene, then the permanent-water, slope and HAND masks.
Labels come from the simulated flood the detector was never shown. In live mode these would be Sen1Floods11 or Copernicus EMS rapid-mapping labels.
